create_cli_typer_app: create a Typer-based CLI app with HFCliApp that supports command aliases, topic grouping, and global formatting flags
run_cli_update: run the install-method-appropriate update command for the hf CLI using pip, brew, or hf_installer
parse_env_map: parse CLI environment variable and secret arguments into a dictionary with HF token injection from dotenv files

parse_volumes: parse volume specification strings from CLI arguments into Volume objects with mount path and read-only flags
